SELECT l.id AS lot_id, l.medication_id AS medication_id, m.name AS medication_name, m.unit AS unit, l.lot_number AS lot_number, l.initial_quantity AS initial_quantity, l.remaining_quantity AS remaining_quantity, l.expiry_date AS expiry_date, l.expiry_date < #{today} AS expired, l.status AS status, l.received_at AS received_at, ru.name AS received_by, l.discarded_at AS discarded_at, du.name AS discarded_by, l.discarded_reason AS discarded_reason FROM tb_stock_lot l JOIN tb_medication m ON m.id = l.medication_id JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.id = l.received_by LEFT JOIN tb_user du ON du.id = l.discarded_by
ORDER BY l.expiry_date, l.received_at, l.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
